solution_steps: Activate Monster Reincarnation. Discard Summoned Skull to return Mataza the Zapper to your hand.
Flip summon Magician of Faith and return Axe of Despair to your hand.
Summon Mataza, equip him with the Axe and attack Giant Orc, then attack directly for game.
